name: Silvermere Residence
desc1: This comfortable house is simple in decoration yet still appears to
desc2: be a respectable residence. A large oaken table sits in the middle of
desc3: the room with four simple chairs which surround it. A large fireplace
desc4: is set on the back wall, with a small fire kept alive by husky red
desc5: embers. Shelves line the walls with cookware and simple tools.
desc6: A small stairway leads up to the next floor where you assume sleeping
